results.name: Tricep Extension Machine
instructions: Sit on the tricep extension machine, adjusting the seat height so that your upper arms comfortably rest on the arm pad, with your elbows bent at a 90-degree angle.
Grasp the handles with a neutral grip, ensuring your elbows are below the pivot point.
Push the handles forward by straightening your elbows and fully extending your arms while keeping your upper arms stationary.
Slowly return to the starting position by bending your elbows. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Breathe steadily: exhale as you extend your arms and inhale as you return to the starting position.
Focus on using your triceps to push the handles, avoiding excessive use of your shoulders or back.
Keep your upper arms stationary on the pad to ensure proper form.
results.description: Tricep Extension Machine is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the triceps (upper arms). Performed with a leverage machine, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Forearms.

results.name: Tricep Rope Extension on Crossover Machine
instructions: Attach a rope to a high cable and hold the ends with your palms facing each other.
Keep your elbows tucked at your sides.
Push the rope down until your arms are straight, separating the ends at the bottom.
Return slowly to about 90 degrees at the elbow and repeat.
tips: Only your forearms move.
Squeeze your triceps at the bottom.
results.description: Tricep Rope Extension on Crossover Machine is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the triceps (upper arms). Performed with a cable, it falls under the strength category.

results.name: 3 Leg Chaturanga Pose
instructions: Start in a plank position with your hands shoulder-width apart and feet hip-width apart.
Lift your right leg straight back and up, keeping your hips level.
Shift your body forward into a plank position while keeping the right leg lifted.
Lower your body towards the floor by bending your elbows close to your sides, maintaining a straight line from head to left heel. Return to the plank position and repeat on the left side.
tips: Engage your core to maintain balance and stability throughout the movement.
Keep your elbows close to your body to protect your shoulders.
Breathe steadily, inhaling as you lower and exhaling as you push back up.
results.description: 3 Leg Chaturanga Pose is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the pectorals (chest). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Abdominals, Obliques, Glutes.

results.name: 3 Leg Dog Pose
instructions: Start in a downward-facing dog position with your hands shoulder-width apart and feet hip-width apart.
Lift your right leg straight back and up, keeping your hips level and ensuring your body forms a straight line from your wrists to your raised foot.
Hold the position, keeping your core engaged and your leg extended.
Lower your right leg back to the floor and return to the plank position. Repeat with the left leg.
tips: Engage your core to maintain balance and stability throughout the movement.
Keep your hips squared to the floor to ensure proper alignment.
Breathe steadily, inhaling as you lift your leg and exhaling as you lower it.
results.description: 3 Leg Dog Pose is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Calves, Core.

results.name: Ab Wheel Plank
instructions: Start by kneeling on a mat with the ab wheel placed on the floor in front of you, holding it with both hands. Ensure your arms are extended and your back is straight.
Roll the ab wheel forward until your body is in a plank position, with your arms extended and your body forming a straight line from head to knees.
Hold the plank position, keeping your core engaged and your body stable, as long as required.
Roll the ab wheel back to the starting position.
tips: Keep your spine neutral and avoid letting your lower back sag. This helps protect your spine and ensures proper form.
Focus on engaging your entire core, including your abdominals, obliques, and lower back, to maintain stability.
Roll out and back in with controlled movements to maximize muscle engagement and minimize the risk of injury.
results.description: Ab Wheel Plank is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a wheel roller, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Obliques, Hip Flexors.

results.name: Alternate Sprinter Lunge
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart.
Lunge back with your right leg, bending both knees to lower your body into a lunge position while reaching your hands towards your left foot.
Push off your right foot to return to the starting position.
Lunge back with your left leg, reaching your hands towards your right foot. Continue alternating sides.
tips: Keep your core engaged to maintain balance and stability throughout the exercise.
Ensure your front knee does not extend past your toes to avoid strain on your knee joint.
Perform the movement slowly and with control to maximize muscle activation and prevent injury.
results.description: Alternate Sprinter Lunge is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors, Calves.

results.name: Alternating Leg Downward Dog
instructions: Start in a downward dog position with your hands and feet on the mat, hips lifted towards the ceiling, and body forming an inverted V shape.
Bend your right knee towards your chest, keeping your foot on the floor and maintaining balance on your left foot and both hands.
Straighten your right leg back to the starting position.
Bend your left knee towards your chest while maintaining balance. Continue alternating sides.
tips: Keep your core engaged to maintain stability and balance throughout the exercise.
Focus on keeping your hips squared and aligned with the mat to avoid twisting your body.
Perform the movement slowly and with control to maximize muscle activation and prevent injury.
results.description: Alternating Leg Downward Dog is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the hamstrings (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Calves, Core.

results.name: Archer Stepback
instructions: Stand tall with your back straight and feet shoulder-width apart.
Extend your arms forward while keeping your palms inward.
Take a step backward by extending your left leg behind you while taking your elbow past your back like an archer.
Hold for a while, return to the initial position, and repeat by taking your right leg backward.
tips: Engage your core to maintain balance and stability throughout the exercise.
Ensure your front knee is aligned with your ankle and does not extend past your toes to avoid strain on your knee joint.
Perform the movement with controlled motions to maximize muscle activation and prevent injury.
results.description: Archer Stepback is an advanced multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Obliques, Hip Flexors.

results.name: Bow Pose
instructions: Lie face down with your legs stretched back and your arms extended in front of you, palms facing down.
Bend your knees and reach back to grasp your ankles with your hands.
Lift your chest and thighs off the floor by pressing your legs into your hands until you feel a comfortable stretch.
Hold the position for the desired duration, then slowly lower your body and release your ankles.
tips: Engage your core to help stabilize your spine.
Avoid forcing the stretch beyond a comfortable range of motion.
Lift your chest by pressing your legs into your hands rather than pulling with your arms.
Breathe slowly and evenly while holding the stretch.
results.description: Bow Pose is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the spine (back). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Chest, Hip Flexors.

results.name: Cat Pose
instructions: Begin on all fours with your hands directly under your shoulders and your knees under your hips. Keep your arms straight and your gaze toward the floor.
Slowly round your back toward the ceiling by tucking your chin toward your chest and drawing your tailbone underneath you.
Hold the stretched position briefly while keeping your shoulders relaxed and your core gently engaged.
Return to the starting position with control and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your hands directly beneath your shoulders and your knees beneath your hips.
Draw your belly button inward to help deepen the spinal movement.
Round your spine evenly from your neck to your lower back.
Inhale in the starting position and exhale as you round your back.
results.description: Cat Pose is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the spine (back). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Core, Upper Back, Shoulders.
